audit.title: Elements with visible text labels do not have matching accessible names.
audit.description: Visible text labels that do not match the accessible name can result in a confusing experience for screen reader users. [Learn more about accessible names](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.13/label-content-name-mismatch).
